HOHUNET SERDESX PLATFORM
PERFORMANCE
High Performance Switching Hardware Platform
Platform Overview
SerdesX platform a high-performance, high-density hardware switching platform that provides high-bandwidth network support for AI applications. SerdexX platform supports multiple port forms such as 100G/200G/400G/800G and can adapt to various network deployment requirements.
Key Features of the SerdesX Platform
Rich network virtualization and intelligent lossless network features, support priority-based flow control (PFC), explicit congestion notification (ECN), MLAG (Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation) etc.
Full set of Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocol.
Intelligent Ethernet OAM Security feature set.
